parsed.explanation: No criminal offence targets trans identity or presentation, same-sex conduct is lawful, and no universal visitor-facing exposure (facility ban, birth-sex custody/ward rule, document-check regime) is documented. Against that: law enforcement is documented as a hostile actor (LGBTQ police blackmail, 2018; 2025 monitoring records high stigma particularly from police), state-tolerated targeting sits atop a hostile legislative/media campaign and a recorded post-2014 surge in attacks, with no non-discrimination statute or shown remedy — thin or no recourse. Threat-framing by legislators exceeds mere friction. Custody placement and care access for visitors (age-25 treatment floor) remain adverse or open. No documented killings or imprisonment for being trans keeps this above the 0.35 tier of institutional universal exposure and routine in-person extortion; absent working protections and with a backsliding trajectory, it stays in Elevated Risk.
